messages:
Maya P.: Heads up — got a batch of Marketplace SI leads from the joint announcement pipeline. We need quick alignment on intake + claim rules so nothing falls through. Who's owning claims? :eyes:

Kevin L.: I can take named accounts in NA. For anything with an active AE, AE owns. Question: do we prioritize marketplace leads over inbound SDR?

Sam R. (RevOps): Prioritization order: 1) Named account with AE > 2) SI partner explicitly assigned > 3) Marketplace inbound. Claim window: 72h after lead created, else auto-assign to PARTNERS_SI queue. Tagging: add lead_source=marketplace, si_partner=<partner_name>. See playbook: https://redwood.ai/partner-playbooks/si-intake :link:

Tara S.: For SI co-sell we require: 1) contact intro email 2) short opp summary + expected ARR 3) partner signoff (POC or MOU). If partner doesn't provide within 72h we fallback to PARTNERS_SI. +1 on 72h claim window.

Jess C.: Drafting a tiny playbook snippet — will paste to ops channel and add to wiki:
```
- Create lead in SF with tags: source=partner_marketplace, partner=ACME-SI
- Post message to #partners-intake with lead link + contact
- 72h timer -> if unclaimed -> route to queue PARTNERS_SI
- Owner claims by replying `claim @<owner>`
```
This keeps Slack as homebase.

deploy-bot: New form available: https://forms.redwood.ai/si-claim — saves to SF queue PARTNERS_SI :robot_face:

Kevin L.: Can we automate claim if owner uses `claim`? Ops can run small lambda to parse messages.

Sam R. (RevOps): Yes — we have webhook that listens to /partners-intake, parses `claim @` and assigns owner in SF. I'll surface the handler. We just need consistent mention format (e.g. `claim @Kevin L.`).

Maya P.: Good. One wrinkle: overlapping territories — what if an account is in EU and both EU AE and SI want to claim?

Tara S.: Territory rules: AE assigned by SF account owner gets priority. If no AE, SI partner wins if they have a preexisting engagement (must include signed MOU). Otherwise marketplace inbound wins. We'll add that to the playbook.

Jess C.: Minimal lead fields for claim:
- company_domain
- contact_email
- estimated_value
- partner_name
- contact_phone (if available)
I'll add these to the form and validation.

Sam R. (RevOps): Action items:
- Sam: implement auto-assign after 72h to PARTNERS_SI
- Jess: update form + wiki and add validation for minimal fields
- Tara: publish SI evidence checklist (MOU template + required emails)
- Kevin/Maya: run triage for current batch and flag any disputes
ETA: EOD Wed. :calendar:

Maya P.: Perfect — I'll run a sweep now and DM folks for edge cases. Thanks team :pray:
